title: 第十九章 气海境六层返回苏家第二十章 狠狠打脸
content_zh:
第十九章：气海境六层，返回苏家“商议婚事？”听到这话的苏命眉头猛然一皱。
现在的赵月如对他而言根本就无关紧要，可她才跟苏命退婚，转头就跟苏权商议婚事，这种举动多少有些侮辱人了。
仆人说完后就深深低着头，潜龙城谁都知道苏命喜欢赵月如到了骨头里，为了赵月如，苏命更是做出了许多荒唐的事情。
他害怕苏命知道这个消息后会发狂。
但令他疑惑的是，等了许久，也不见苏命有什么反应。
“行了，你先回去吧，晚些时候我自会回来。”苏命轻轻摆手，脸色平淡如水。
“啊？”仆人微微一愣，脸上露出惊疑之色。
不怪仆人诧异，实在是苏命的反应太过平淡。
虽说不知道为什么会是这样，但仆人还是快步离去。
孤身一人，苏命眼底露出冰冷戏谑的神色，口中喃喃自语：
“苏权……你终于是要回来了吗？”
……
潜龙城外一片偏僻的山谷中。
苏命盘膝坐在谷内，双手各自握着一把灵石。
不用想也知道，这次回苏家必定有一场腥风血雨。所以在这之前，苏命必须尽可能的变强。
“之前先是猎杀妖兽、又和女帝切磋了一番，加上和柳关河一战，我之前的境界也算是彻底稳固了，如今，也是该突破境界的时候了。”
双目紧闭，死神诀骤然运转。
无数灵石发出氤氲的光泽，澎拜的灵气弥漫而出，将此地以及萧元辰彻底淹没。
一炷香后！
“轰！”

山谷内响起一声巨响，苏命的气息瞬间攀升了一截。
“气海境四层！”
看着地上数百颗已经化作齑粉的灵石，苏命心头微震：
“果然，随着境界提升，我现在想要突破境界需要的资源也越来越多。但好在境界提升给我带来的增幅也变得更大了。”
苏命握紧拳头，对着虚空一拳轰出。
恐怖的气浪喷涌而出，直接在不远处的山崖上轰出一个坑洞。
“现在的我要是再对上柳关河，恐怕光是九截剑也足以杀他。”微微一笑，苏命闭上双眼，再度陷入了修炼状态。
半个时辰后，苏命的气息再度攀升。
“气海境五层！”
但苏命却并未停止，而是继续修炼！
又是一个时辰过去，在消耗了两千灵石以及死神塔存储的所有灵气之后，苏命的气息再度暴涨。
“气海境六层！”
结束修炼，苏命睁开双眼，双目之中顿时闪过夺目的光芒。
虽说只是看似从气海境三层突破到了气海境六层，可对于苏命的战力而言却是一个质的提升。
他估计着，自己至少比之前强了一倍。
现在的他自信，便是不用武技，他也可以击杀金丹修士。
要是动用武技，金丹境界之内他可以无敌！
content_en:
Chapter 19: The sixth level of the Qi Sea Realm, returning to the Su family. "Discussing marriage?" Su Ming frowned suddenly when he heard this.
Zhao Yueru was of no importance to him now, but she had just broken off her engagement with Su Ming and then turned around to discuss marriage with Su Quan. This behavior was somewhat insulting.
After the servant finished speaking, he lowered his head deeply. Everyone in Qianlong City knew that Su Ming loved Zhao Yueru to the core. For Zhao Yueru, Su Ming did many ridiculous things.
He was afraid that Su Ming would go crazy when he knew the news.
But what puzzled him was that after waiting for a long time, Su Ming didn't see any reaction.
"Okay, you go back first, I will be back later." Su Ming waved his hand gently, his face as calm as water.
"Ah?" The servant was stunned for a moment, with a look of surprise on his face.
It's not surprising that the servant was surprised, Su Ming's reaction was actually too bland.
Although he didn't know why this was happening, the servant left quickly.
Alone, Su Ming had a cold and playful look in his eyes, and murmured to himself:
"Su Quan...are you finally coming back?"
…
In a remote valley outside Qianlong City.
Su Ming sat cross-legged in the valley, holding a handful of spiritual stones in each hand.
You don't need to think about it to know that there will be a bloody storm when you return to the Su family this time. So before that, Su Ming must become as strong as possible.
"Before, I hunted monsters and sparred with the Empress. In addition, after the battle with Liu Guanhe, my previous realm was completely stable. Now, it is time to break through the realm."
With his eyes closed tightly, the Death Technique suddenly started to work.
Countless spiritual stones gave off a dense luster, and the surging spiritual energy filled the air, completely submerging this place and Xiao Yuanchen.
After a stick of incense!
"Boom!"
There was a loud noise in the valley, and Su Ming's aura instantly increased.
"Fourth level of Qi Sea Realm!"
Looking at the hundreds of spiritual stones on the ground that had turned into powder, Su Ming's heart was slightly shaken:
"Sure enough, as the realm improves, I now need more and more resources to break through the realm. But fortunately, the increase brought to me by the improvement of the realm has also become greater."
Su Ming clenched his fist and punched the void.
The terrifying air wave spurted out, directly blasting a hole in the cliff not far away.
"If I were to face Liu Guanhe again now, I'm afraid that the nine-section sword alone would be enough to kill him." Su Ming smiled slightly, closed his eyes, and fell into a cultivation state again.
Half an hour later, Su Ming's aura increased again.
"Fifth level of Qi Sea Realm!"
But Su Ming did not stop, but continued to practice!
Another hour passed, and after consuming two thousand spiritual stones and all the spiritual energy stored in the Death Tower, Su Ming's aura surged again.
"Sixth level of Qi Sea Realm!"
After finishing his training, Su Ming opened his eyes, and a dazzling light suddenly flashed in his eyes.
Although it only seemed like he had broken through from the third level of the Qi Sea Realm to the sixth level of the Qi Sea Realm, it was a qualitative improvement for Su Ming's combat power.
He estimated that he was at least twice as strong as before.
Now he is confident that he can kill the golden elixir monk even without using martial arts.
If he uses martial arts, he can be invincible within the Golden Core realm!
